top_signals.title: Crypto Industry Will Get Rules One Way or Another, Selig Says
top_signals.summary: The crypto industry will get market structure rules even if Congress fails to pass landmark legislation, the head of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission said Thursday.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin surges 11% in two days as Trump, crypto execs lead last ditch effort for Clarity Act
top_signals.summary: Bitcoin is trading at its highest levels since early June as crypto execs joined with President Donald Trump push to get the Clarity Act over the finish line.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: US Weekly Jobless Claims Edge Lower to 206,000
top_signals.summary: Applications for US unemployment benefits decreased by 6,000 to 206,000 in the week ended Aug. 15, according to Labor Department data released Thursday. Claims stayed near historically low levels and suggested few layoffs across the labor market. Enda Curran reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: TPG-Backed Korean Ride-Hailing Firm Eyes ADR After Hynix Triumph
top_signals.summary: Kakao Mobility is considering listing shares held by TPG Capital on a US exchange, seeking to tap the global appetite for Korean companies highlighted by SK Hynix Inc.’s blockbuster offering last month.

top_signals.title: Alibaba shares fall 6% as AI spending drives 75% drop in net income
top_signals.summary: Alibaba's U.S. listed shares were volatile in premarket trading after posting a 75% drop in net income in the June quarter.
